first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because onboarding completion is down 4% and prior evidence suggests it can improve both completion and early activation without sacrificing long-term value. I will verify the two onboarding findings and the promotional-pricing record to assess whether pricing is a stronger competing response, while keeping the initial test guarded to protect qualified revenue. The pricing threat and possible downstream revenue or retention tradeoffs remain uncertain.

final.rationale: Run a randomized onboarding-shortening experiment this week, focused on the affected self-serve SMB flow, with activation, completion, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue as guardrails. Shortened onboarding has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, and retention, directly addressing both current problems. Signup simplification is a viable secondary variant but carries a modest retention decline, while targeted discounting produces unsustainable first-renewal churn and should not be used.
